rules: The post-Batch failure set must be a subset of the accepted 11 IDs.
No Books, About, Hero, Media, runtime, content, or other test outside the accepted set may fail.
Frozen core metrics must not materially worsen.
No test may be skipped, filtered out of the final aggregate, or weakened; no assertion or Hero/Media parameter may be changed to satisfy the gate.
